title: Study to Assess Efficacy and Safety of HSK39297 Tablets in Patients With LN
off: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase II Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HSK39297 Tablets in Patients With Lupus Nephritis

officials.a: Institute of Nephrology, Zhong Da Hospital, Southeast University School of Medicine

summary: A double-blind,placebo controlled,randomized Phase 2 study to evaluate the safety and tolerability of once-daily, oral administration of 200 or 300 mg HSK39297 tablets versus placebo in Patients With Lupus Nephritis

arms.d: Patients take double-blind HSK39297 tablets 200mg for 52 weeks
Patients take double-blind HSK39297 tablets 300mg for 52 weeks
Patients take double-blind placebo for 52 weeks
